messages:
maria: FYI launching a small preview of ephemeral CI runners on AWS Fargate. auth uses OIDC role binding and short-lived creds. looking for 3-5 canary repos this week. details below.

jonathan: Nice. How are we gating who uses them? repo-level? team-level?

maria: Repo-level. add the `fargate-preview` runner label to opt in. initial canary list: devex/ci-templates, infra/infra-templates, web-app/frontend, data/etl.

rahul: Secrets/access? we can't expose deploy keys.

maria: Runners assume an IAM role via OIDC; secrets fetched at runtime from SSM Parameter Store with KMS. no static PATs. we also rotate the role session every 1h.

anna: Observability integration? dashboards?

jonathan: They emit OTLP spans and CloudWatch logs. i'll add task-arn -> traceID mapping and update dashboards.

sam: Cost control? matrix builds could be expensive if many tasks spawn.

maria: Preview caps: concurrency cap 30 tasks per cluster, budget alarm when cost delta > 10% vs baseline. autoscaler will respect the cap.

rahul: Fallback if Fargate capacity is exhausted?

maria: Route policy falls back to static self-hosted pool `legacy-pool`. no jobs will be dropped. routing rules in devex/ci-routing repo.

anna: i'll open a PR to update the CI runbook and incident playbook (runbook PR #88). include drain steps and log lookup.

jonathan: Can we restrict privileged runners? some jobs require host mounts.

maria: Privileged jobs are excluded from ephemeral by default. we detect `runs-on: self-hosted+privileged` and keep them on legacy runners.

sam: i'll volunteer web-app/frontend to test; will run a full pipeline tomorrow AM. ping me the exact label.

ci-bot: build #4026 (web-app/frontend) started on runner ephemeral-2a9f

ci-bot: build #4026 succeeded on ephemeral-2a9f :white_check_mark:

rahul: Logs look ok; one intermittent warning about file descriptors hitting the ulimit in the test container.

maria: filed devex/ci-ops issue with log excerpt and mitigation steps.

jonathan: note: keep infra/critical and infra/quick-infra out until caching and warm-starts validated.

maria: Agreed. infra/critical excluded for now.

anna: Timeline?

maria: Preview this week, expand to beta in 2 weeks if stable, GA rollout in ~6 weeks. we'll publish a canary metrics snapshot after 72h. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks, we'll report any flakiness.

maria: DM me if you want early access or help adding labels.
